source.section: Instructions PDF pp.9-10, Schedule M line 1t, questions 1 and 2 and table lines 1-4; Worksheet Step 1 lines 1-7, Step 2 lines 8-13 and instructions PDF p.9, Schedule M line 1s; Instructions PDF p.4, RI-1040 lines 1-5; PDF p.5, lines 6-8; PDF p.13, Tax Computation Worksheet ('Use for all filing status types')

worked: Federal AGI = private pension (person 0) 60,000.00 + private pension (person 1) 10,050.00 + taxable Social Security 34,000.00 + interest 29,700.01 = 133,750.01. Federal taxable income = 133,750.01 - 31,500.00 standard deduction - 2 x 1,600.00 age 65+ = 99,050.01 (given, not tested; federal senior deduction ignored). RI-1040 line 1 federal AGI 133,750.01. Line 1s, Social Security worksheet: person 0 born 1950-06-15 (age 75), person 1 born 1951-06-15 (age 74). Line 3 federal AGI 133,750.01; line 4 Married filing jointly; line 5 born on or before 03/01/1959: yes; line 6 133,750.00; line 7 133,750.01 less than 133,750.00: no. STOP: not eligible; modification 0.00. Line 1t: question 1 born on or before March 1, 1959: person 0 born 1950-06-15 (age 75), person 1 born 1951-06-15 (age 74): yes; question 2 federal AGI 133,750.01 less than or equal to 133,750.00: no. Not both yes: no table, modification 0.00. Line 1y total decreasing modifications = 0.00. Line 2a other-state obligations 0.00; line 2m total increasing modifications = 0.00. Schedule M page 2 line 3 net = 0.00 - 0.00 = 0.00; RI-1040 line 2 = 0.00. Line 3 modified federal AGI = 133,750.01 + (0.00) = 133,750.01. Standard Deduction and Exemption Worksheets: line 3 133,750.01 is not more than 254,250.00: the worksheets stop at line 3, full amounts. Line 4 standard deduction: 21,800.00 (Married filing jointly). Line 5 = 133,750.01 - 21,800.00 = 111,950.01. Line 6 exemptions: 2 x 5,100.00 = 10,200.00. Line 7 taxable income = 111,950.01 - 10,200.00 = 101,750.01. Line 8 tax on 101,750.01 by the schedule as numbers: 79,900.00 x 0.0375 = 2996.2500 + 21,850.01 x 0.0475 = 1037.875475 = 4034.125475, 4,034.13 to the cent. Credits 0.00 (Schedule I, Schedule II, RI earned income credit and RI-1040H are not modelled and not claimed here). Rhode Island income tax = 4,034.13. Note: One cent over 133,750: both tests fail and both modifications are lost.
